class.name: InputMapSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [InputMapSettingsServer]: the events of all [InputMap] actions.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"input_map"[/code]: one [InputMapAction] per bound slot of every action, grouped by action. It holds nothing but the list, so [InputMapSettingsServer] can store it as CSV with one row per event. [InputMapSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]); use the methods of [InputMapSettingsServer] to change the events.

members.member: The rows, one per slot. An action without any event has one empty row that carries its [member InputMapAction.deadzone].
